preconditions.expression: isinstance(image, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in image)
preconditions.description: image is a 2-D array of integers.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(pixel, int) and 0 <= pixel <= 10 for row in image for pixel in row)
preconditions.description: Each pixel value in the image is an integer between 0 and 10 inclusive.
The dimensions of the image are between 1x1 and 100x100.
sr is a valid row index in the image.
sc is a valid column index in the image.
newColor is an integer between 0 and 10 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The return value is a 2-D array of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(pixel, int) and 0 <= pixel <= 10 for row in return_value for pixel in row)
postconditions.description: Each pixel value in the return value is an integer between 0 and 10 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(image) and all(len(row) == len(image[i]) for i, row in enumerate(return_value))
postconditions.description: The dimensions of the return value match the dimensions of the input image.
The starting pixel (sr, sc) is colored with the newColor.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[r][c] == newColor if image[r][c] == image[sr][sc] else return_value[r][c] == image[r][c] for r in range(len(image)) for c in range(len(image[0])))
postconditions.description: All pixels connected 4-directionally to the starting pixel with the same color are colored with the newColor, and other pixels remain unchanged.
